gates.name: Local authorization
gates.predicate: Authenticated actor with explicit project/account capability; no secret resolution

gates.name: Sealed contract
gates.predicate: Strict schema, unknown keys refused; all semantic decisions present; refs scoped; source/recipe current; no active input

gates.name: Eligibility
gates.predicate: Account active/BRL, Page tasks, selected identity, immutable image+destination, special category decision and verified recipe

gates.name: Durable validation
gates.predicate: Server receipt, exact hash/API/account/actor/steps/coverage/zeroobjects/timestamps; explicit success only

gates.name: Operator approval
gates.predicate: Unexpired one-execution approval over plan/hash/budget/currency/manifest/actor/limits and partial-validation disclosure

gates.name: Dispatch flags
gates.predicate: Creation flag and ledger flag independently required; validation flag grants no create authority

gates.name: Dispatch journal
gates.predicate: Durable intent/step attempt owner before dispatch; CAS single sender; known/ambiguous steps never resend
gates.timing: Durably before each CREATE/UPDATE POST; read/validate may resolve token after their own local gates. No provider write without dispatch ownership.

gates.name: Read-back
gates.predicate: Known identity, parents, configuredPAUSED, critical payload semantics and presence; persist requested/observed diffs

gates.name: Recovery authority
gates.predicate: Read/ledger recovery capability independent of create; frozen identities and snapshot; never recompile to decide new creation

gates.name: Mutation diff
gates.predicate: Fresh before-image and allowed field diff, operation-specific approval, bounded budget, optimistic precondition

gates.name: Future activation
gates.predicate: Independent release/capability/approval over verified paused hierarchy; no route exists in P0

gates.name: Privacy
gates.predicate: Policy/consent/purpose/retention and account binding; no PII/secrets in browser/receipts

gates.name: Official schema
gates.predicate: Independently approved candidate; checkpoint; authorized migration; RPC/RLS/grants and role tests

hash_contract.canonicalization: Versioned canonical JSON, UTF8, lexicographic object keys, preserve ordered operation/variation arrays; no float money; reject duplicate keys/NaN; timestamps canonicalUTC. Byte-level serialization cross-language golden fixtures required.
hash_contract.postcompile_binding: Approval separately seals actor, hash, expiry, validation_receipt and execution_ref. Dependency substitution only predefined slots; hash instantiated payload per step before dispatch.
hash_contract.url_policy: Exact approved URL after a versioned explicit normalization at draft time; reject userinfo, private/loopback/link-local/multicast destinations, unsafe redirects and PII query before approval. No automatic correction at dispatch.

idempotency.approval_uniqueness: validation receipt binds at most one approval; approval binds at most one execution; same key/hash retrieves same state
idempotency.concurrent_request: Return existing execution/in_progress; never turn a live owner into failed/absent or dispatch again.

crash_policy.after_journal_before_send: Treat orphan as potentially dispatched unless transport proof establishes otherwise; no automatic retry.
crash_policy.after_partial_tree: Keep existing parentsPAUSED; no new children without explicit resume of same approved execution and current authorization.

idempotency.creative_reuse: Provider may return existing Creative; classify REUSED_PROVIDER and verify full content/identity; local auto-adoption across distinct approvals forbidden.
idempotency.dispatch_fence: Persist owner/attempt/fence before external call; ensure only one owned dispatch. Lease expiry alone never permits another POST. A late worker cannot prove no external side effect by losing its lease.
idempotency.provider_idempotency: No undocumented Meta idempotency header/key assumed; client exactly-once external delivery cannot be guaranteed.

invariants: Approving does not create; creating executes frozen decisions; reconciling does not resend.
Remote validation uses explicit execution_options validate_only and never becomes creation through an omitted option.
Local validation and server authorization precede secret resolution; expired approval never touches token.
One approval grants one execution identity, not one HTTP attempt; repeated calls return that execution state.
Unknown boolean/null/missing list is not false/zero/empty. No semantically active omission without operator decision and source.
Persist dispatch intent before create POST; persist returned ID before read-back; do not depend on browser memory.
A timeout after possible dispatch is ambiguous, unlike a proved provider refusal; no automatic retry of ambiguous creation.
Absence by name/time/empty edge does not establish never-created;120seconds is not a causal proof.
Reconciliation can attach known/proven identity but cannot change approved intent, adopt arbitrary twin or create missing child.
No Campaign/AdSet/Ad request status ACTIVE or ENABLED; AdCreative has separate non-delivery library status.
Critical read-back divergence/unknown is durable and prevents green receipt and continuation.
Close create flag on any terminal/error outcome; recovery reading remains available under its own gate.
Provider normalization permitted only by field-specific equivalence, never arbitrary URL slash stripping.
Approval cannot survive content/identity/destination/recipe/budget or behavior-policy change.

conditional_required: destination_type according to adjudicated Traffic recipe
destination_spec once official read mask adjudicated
name only if provider-created new rather than documented reuse

receipt_contract.limits_authority: VOLC policy retained from current candidate, not Meta requirement
receipt_contract.sensitive_storage: Full payload/copy/destination are strategic confidential data, not secrets; encrypt access-controlled immutable envelope and store digest/minimal projection in ledger. No token/headers/PII/credential locators.
receipt_contract.zero_objects_rule: Required integer exactly0 for validation, missing invalid; root proof never changes child status.

retry_policy.ambiguous_update: Read current state first; optimistic conditions and renewed authority before reapplying.
retry_policy.ledger_failure: Stop dispatch, retain recoverable IDs where durably known; no green receipt.
retry_policy.local_validation: Retry after corrected draft invalidates old hash/approval.
retry_policy.proved_refusal: Record code/subcode/status and no-ID refusal; no blind same-intent retry; corrected plan/new approval or explicitly authorized resume.
retry_policy.provider_read: Bounded exponential backoff with jitter and usage/Retry-After when supplied; max5attempts within operator deadline; preserve partiality.
retry_policy.remote_validate: May retry exact validation request under gate; no ad objects created; record each result.
